get.summary: List message summaries in an IMAP folder.
get.description:
Ordering is arrival-based: IMAP UIDs increase as messages arrive, so
`sort=date_desc` (default) walks from the highest UID down and
`sort=date_asc` from the lowest UID up; the `cursor` parameter acts as a
`before_uid` for `date_desc` and an `after_uid` for `date_asc`. Within
each returned page the summaries are refined by their parsed Date header.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: UID of the last message returned by the previous date-sorted page.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort order: `date_desc` (default, newest first) or `date_asc`
(oldest first). Unknown values are rejected with 400.

# Endpoint
`PATCH /api/users/me/theme`

# Authentication
Requires valid JWT token.

# Request Body
```json
{
  "theme": "light" | "dark" | "system"

```

- 200 OK: Theme updated successfully
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid theme value
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid token
- 500 Internal Server Error: Database error

get.summary: Get session status (for resume)
get.description:
GET /api/v1/uploads/sessions/{id}

Returns the current status of an upload session, including which
chunks have been received and which are missing. Clients use this
to resume interrupted uploads.

DELETE /api/v1/uploads/sessions/{id}

Cancels an in-progress upload and cleans up temporary storage.

put.description:
PUT /api/v1/uploads/sessions/{id}/chunks/{index}

Uploads a single chunk of data. The Content-MD5 header can be
provided for integrity verification.

- Content-MD5: Base64-encoded MD5 hash of the chunk (optional but recommended)

post.description:
POST /api/v1/uploads/sessions/{id}/complete

Finalizes the upload by assembling all chunks into the final file,
verifying the content hash, creating the file metadata, and cleaning
up temporary chunk storage.

```json

  "name": "string | null",
  "surname": "string | null",
  "display_name": "string",
```

- 400 Bad Request: Invalid request data
- 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid authentication
- 404 Not Found: User not found
- 500 Internal Server Error: Database error

get.summary: Readiness probe endpoint (`GET /ready`).
get.description:
Returns `200 OK` when all required dependencies are healthy.
Returns `503 Service Unavailable` when any required dependency is unhealthy.

Components checked:
- `database`        – metadata projection DB connectivity
- `object_storage`  – S3/RustFS bucket accessibility
- `event_delivery`  – event store DB + in-memory broadcaster health
- `auth_session`    – JWT signing/verification + session table accessibility
- `ai`              – AI service presence (optional; does not fail readiness)
- `outbox`          – durable integration-event outbox dispatcher tick
                      freshness (informational; does not fail readiness)

Event.description: Event stored in the event store

File.description:
File metadata for a user's uploaded file.

Files use content-addressed storage where the actual file content is stored
in object storage using the content hash as the key.

FileVersion.description:
A version snapshot of a file's content.

Each time a file is modified, a new version is created with the updated content hash.

FileWithShares.description: File with share information for list responses

share_expires_at.description: Earliest share expiration date (None if no shares have expiration)

Folder.description:
A folder that organizes files in a hierarchical structure.

Folders form a tree structure where each folder can have a parent folder.
The root folder has no parent.

ancestor_ids.description:
Ancestor folder IDs (parent, grandparent, etc.) for efficient permission resolution.
Stored as Option for backward compatibility with folders created before this field existed.

FolderContents.description:
A flat representation of folder contents.

Contains the files and immediate subfolders in a directory,
without recursing into subdirectories.

FolderTree.description:
A recursive representation of folder structure.

Contains a folder and all its subfolders recursively, along with files
at each level. This provides a complete tree view of the folder hierarchy.

FolderTreeNode.description: Folder tree node with share information for sidebar

FolderTreeWithShares.description: Folder tree response with share indicators

FolderWithShares.description: Folder with share information for list responses

share_expires_at.description: Earliest share expiration date (None if no shares have expiration)

size.description: Total recursive size of all non-deleted files within this folder (in bytes)

IncomingChatEvent.description: Incoming chat event from external chat system.

NoteConflict.description:

and bundle folder name of an OKF-native note.

NoteSummary.description: Note summary for listings (includes file id but not full content).

Notification.description:
In-app notification for a user.

Notifications are persistent and stored in the database. They complement
real-time WebSocket notifications for offline users.

action_url.description: Optional deep link to the resource

client_secret.description: `"***"` when a secret is stored; `null` when none is set.

ReadinessResponse.description:
Operational readiness response.

Distinct from the lightweight liveness probe (`/health`), this endpoint
checks every runtime dependency required for the server to serve traffic.

RegisterWebhookRequest.description: Request to register a new webhook URL.

RenameVaultFileRequest.description: Request to rename a file within a vault.

ResourceType.description: Type of resource referenced by notification.

in_reply_to.description:
Raw Message-ID / References for replies to remote-only messages; kept
with the draft so threading survives save/reload. See
`SendOutboundMailRequest`.

color.description:
`None` = omitted/no change, `Some(None)` = explicit `null`/clear,

Canonical `elembra://` resource reference (the cross-Application
identity contract; feed it back into source authorization to open).

Raw Message-ID of the message being replied to, for replies to messages
that were never imported into RustShare. Ignored when
`in_reply_to_msg_id` resolves to a stored message, and for forwards.

references.description: Raw References chain (Message-IDs) for remote-only replies.

Share.description:
A share link that allows access to a file or folder.

Supports both public shares (anonymous access via token), user shares
(authenticated user-to-user sharing), and group shares (access via group membership).

access_count.description: Access count for public shares only

expires_at.description: Expiration time for public shares only

file_id.description: File being shared (None for folder shares)
